existingArchitecture.detail: Existing source config ARTICLE/SITEMAP/RSS/SEARCH, sourceDraft/allowedSourceUrl; search default OFF, no approved search provider or external query dispatched.
Existing pinned HTTPS/SSRF/robots/body/redirect/timeout caps; atomic publisher-family rate reservations added. No second crawler.
Existing article selection, canonical geography, evidence locators and cost typed extractor; explicit meal/person-meal units added, no unit guessing.

Existing PG jobs, advisory claim lock, lease token/recovery, max attempts12, conditional GET and abort; exact source scope through prune/enqueue/claim; source interval honored; no schema or scheduler added.
Material normalized field diff ignores irrelevant HTML hash drift; current DRAFT revision required, no approved knowledge overwrite/expiry extension.
Existing admin overview reuses approved repository and returns bounded location/category/authority/gap/health view, canonical public proposals only.
Existing eligibleCostEvidence/compatibility/publisher independence/median/min-max; no GROUP_VND_V1, Planner or Booking edits.
Existing exact selected fact/observation approvals, source/version/expiry guards and PG fresh reads; no Owner identity or consent bypass.
Bounded public-gap metadata in existing cost branch; no raw chat persisted or sent externally; successful-publication/what-if/context guards retained.
Existing /admin/travel-web coverage/job health plus candidate typed previous/proposed changes; no new page or automatic consent.
